The '''Bavva system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bavva/Legends|Bavva]], home of a [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] colony.
